skills.name: init
skills.description: Set up the Claude Code harness for your project. Guided interview configures CLAUDE.md, permissions, hooks, MCP servers, agents, and SSOT docs in one session. Choose Essential (5 min), Standard (15 min), or Full (30 min).

skills.name: new-project
skills.description: Start a new project from scratch. 3-phase interview: project goals → tech stack → architecture → conventions. Scaffolds with official tools and configures the Claude harness. Run on an empty directory.

skills.name: setup-memory
skills.description: Configure project memory: write CLAUDE.md with architecture context and optionally set up .claude/memory/ for persistent cross-session learning.

skills.name: setup-permissions
skills.description: Configure .claude/settings.json with appropriate tool permissions for your stack. Stack-matched presets for Node, Python, Go, Java, Rust.

skills.name: setup-hooks
skills.description: Configure .claude/settings.json hooks for auto-format, auto-lint, and test-on-stop triggers. Detects Prettier, ESLint, Black, Ruff, gofmt, Rustfmt, Jest, pytest, and more.

skills.name: setup-mcp
skills.description: Configure .mcp.json with MCP servers for external services. Registry includes GitHub, Linear, Slack, Sentry, PostgreSQL, Google Drive, Notion, Jira.

skills.name: setup-agents
skills.description: Configure .claude/agents/ with specialized sub-agents. Context-aware suggestions: drift-monitor, pr-review, test-coverage, worker-monitor, dependency-scanner.

skills.name: setup-ssot
skills.description: Set up SSOT documentation: docs/architecture.md, ADR structure with ADR-0001, and CODEMAPS for codebase navigation.

skills.name: review
skills.description: Audit Claude Code harness health: score 8 components, detect drift from codebase, suggest fixes or tier upgrades. Supports --drift-only and --tier-check flags.

skills.name: update-ssot
skills.description: Sync CLAUDE.md and architecture docs with the current codebase state. Section-by-section diff and confirm. Use after adding dependencies, refactoring, or architecture changes.

skills.name: setup-observability
skills.description: Enable tool call logging: installs observe.py hook that writes tool usage metadata to .claude/logs/ for harness optimization. Tier 3 opt-in.
